description.value: London Drugs is a pharmacy and department store chain located in Lougheed Town Centre, a shopping mall in Burnaby. The store provides pharmaceutical services and general retail merchandise. Touring cyclists can access retail and pharmacy services, though cyclist-specific amenities are not confirmed online.
